A-eye

Eyes on the ground
for AI agents.

The problem

Agents can search the web.
They can't see right now.

  • Is there a line at the coffee cart?
  • Is the courtyard busy?
  • Can you see the Campanile?

The web has opening hours and old reviews. The people standing there know the answer. A-eye puts the web's guess next to theirs.

How it works

One question, start to finish.

1 · AskAI agent calls ask_location_question over MCP: pin, radius, deadline, prize
→
2 · Payx402 in AUSD on Base Sepolia. ERC-3009 signature, no gas
→
3 · AnswerPeople nearby get it in the PWA, take an in-app photo, pick an option
→
4 · VerifyGPS ≤ 75 m accuracy and inside radius · captured within 2 min · SHA-256 duplicate check
While open: sealedNo tallies, no photos, so nobody herds. Agents can peek_results for 0.02 AUSD; the fee joins the pot.
At close: fair raffleH(seed ‖ block hash ‖ question_id) mod N. Seed committed up front, revealed at close. Winner gets 90% of the pot.
Nobody answered?The prize is refunded to the agent automatically.
Agent getsPercentages, every photo, the web's answer and the market's odds side by side.

Sponsor integrations

Each one does a real job.

Agora AUSD · x402Pay-per-question and pay-per-peek over x402. Gasless ERC-3009 for agent payments, winner payouts and refunds.
Gemini PredictionsOracle compares the crowd with market odds and places sized sandbox orders when they disagree. Shown as Market vs Humans.
Ripple XRPL · TestnetEscrow + Batch + AMM pay winners in RLUSD atomically. AEYE reputation MPT and Verified Observer credentials.
XRPL Lending · DevnetSingle Asset Vault + Lending Protocol: a vault lends the agent its bounty, and depositors earn the interest.
Context.devPlace context and a "what the web says" answer for every question, shown next to the crowd.
ElevenLabsRead aloud (TTS) and Say your answer (speech-to-text) for hands-free observers.
Cloudflare R2Evidence photo storage behind the app, via the S3 API.
MCP, anywhereHosted /mcp or npx -y a-eye-mcp. One-click for Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

Ripple side challenge

Bounty Credit Vault

An agent can borrow its bounty instead of paying up front.

  • Broker · A-eye creates the vault, sets loan terms, posts first-loss cover
  • Depositor puts in 20 XRP, withdraws with yield at maturity
  • Sponsor deposits 20 XRP and stays invested
  • Borrower · AI agent takes a 20 XRP loan, escrows a 5 XRP bounty, repays with interest
  • Observer receives the bounty

Committed Devnet run: 20,000,000 drops in → 20,000,035 drops out, 35 drops yield. Devnet only: the vault and lending amendments aren't on Testnet yet.
